text: The normal inflammatory markers make active infection or autoimmune arthritis unlikely, and your symptoms of worsening pain with activity and improvement with rest are classic for mechanical osteoarthritis. Have you noticed any bony enlargements or "nodes" on your fingers, wrists, or knees, and do you have a history of fractures or heavy manual labor?
